user.title: TTS HTTP Gateway
user.description: Serves the selected TTS engines at a URL generated from the name and a random string. Each request goes to the first engine; when it fails or doesn't start producing audio in time, the next one takes over.

data_description.name: Only what Home Assistant shows; rename it any time. The URL starts with it in snake_case, e.g. "My Reader" gives /api/tts_http_gateway/my_reader_<random>, and keeps that even after a rename.
data_description.engines: Tried in the order selected. Put the fastest first and the most reliable last.
data_description.language: Language code passed to every engine, e.g. zh-TW. A request can override it with language=.
data_description.rate: A multiple of the normal speed, from 0.25 to 4; 1 is normal. Engines that can't go as far get the nearest speed they can: Azure and Edge 0.5 to 2. Leave empty for each engine's default. A request can override it with rate=.
data_description.pitch: Semitones up or down, from -20 to 20; 0 is normal. Edge only takes Hz, so it gets an approximation that fits a female voice. Leave empty for each engine's default. A request can override it with pitch=.
data_description.volume: A percentage of the normal volume, from 0 to 100; 100 is normal, which is already the loudest for Azure and Edge. Azure Speech TTS doesn't take a volume yet, so only Edge TTS changes it. Leave empty for each engine's default. A request can override it with volume=.
data_description.first_chunk_timeout: How long an engine may take to produce its first audio before the next engine is tried. The last engine always gets at least 30 seconds.

voices.title: Voices
voices.description: The voice of each engine, by its entity ID: voice names differ between platforms, e.g. zh-TW-HsiaoChenNeural on Azure and Edge, cmn-TW-Wavenet-A on Google Cloud. Pick one from the list or type a name; engines that don't list their voices, like Edge TTS, get a text field. Leave a field empty for that engine's default voice. A request's voice= replaces all of them.

error.invalid_rate: The speech rate must be from 0.25 to 4.
error.invalid_pitch: The pitch must be from -20 to 20 semitones.
error.invalid_volume: The volume must be from 0 to 100%.

init.title: TTS HTTP Gateway
init.description:
URL: `{path}?text=...`

The URL works without a password, so keep it secret like one. Add `voice=`, `rate=` (e.g. 1.2), `pitch=` (semitones, e.g. -2) or `volume=` (e.g. 60) to override the settings below for one request.

data_description.regenerate_endpoint: For when the URL leaked. The new URL starts with the current name; the old one stops working immediately, so update it wherever it's used.
